observation.happening: Three-column meeting transcript view: left sidebar (navigation), center (structured meeting summary with decisions/actions/memos, plus transcript log), right panel (speaker detail for selected entry). Timestamps, speaker names, reference numbers linked throughout.
observation.most_important: Decisions, action items, and memos are clearly surfaced from AI-processed transcript. Full transcript available below for reference. Right panel shows full context of any selected item.
observation.next_action: Click transcript entry to drill into speaker context; click decision/memo to filter or navigate; possible edit buttons (inferred from structure)
anomalies: Right panel isolated to single speaker entry (Ken, 10:42) while main area shows summary—creates asymmetric visual weight
Very dense information: three outcome types, numbered items, transcript rows, speaker names, times, and status badges all in view simultaneously

ai_look: Numbered list items feel formulaic (decision [1], action [2], etc.)
Structured categorization (決まったこと / やること / メモ) is systematic but can feel template-like
226C.why: Well-executed productivity UI. Information hierarchy is clear (summary → full transcript), navigation is logical, and the AI-structured output (decisions/actions) is properly surfaced. However, layout follows standard three-column app pattern (Linear, Notion, Slack); no distinctive visual or interaction character. Density is appropriate for the task but verges on overwhelming.

observation.happening: Destructive action confirmation modal. Title asks whether to delete recording. Red warning indicator and explanatory text explain consequence (transcript and grouped items will also delete). Two-button footer: gray 'cancel' (やめる) and red 'delete' (捨てる). ESC hint shown.
observation.most_important: Clear data-loss warning with confirmation required. Red delete button signals irreversibility.
observation.next_action: User must choose: cancel (ESC / やめる) or confirm delete (捨てる)
anomalies: Line '〉 削除せない' appears to be UI artifact or typo—'削除せない' (will not delete) contradicts the dialog intent and is unclear in context. Likely should be '削除について' or similar explanatory label.

2366.why: Textbook destructive-action dialog executed well. Question is prominent, consequence is clearly explained, buttons are appropriately colored and labeled, ESC hint is good UX. However, the typo/artifact '削除せない' is a meaningful flaw—it creates confusion about the actual consequence. The pattern itself is standard (Apple, Google, Linear all use similar). No distinctive character, but that's appropriate for a critical interaction.

observation.happening: Compact floating control bar for active recording. Shows recording status (red dot + '録音中' label), elapsed time (00:00), and action buttons: memo, transcript (字幕), Ask Astra query, visibility toggle (eye), pause, and stop (red dot).
observation.most_important: Clear indication recording is active + quick access to during-call features (notes, transcript, AI copilot, visibility, pause/stop).
observation.next_action: User can pause, add memo, enable captions, query Astra, or stop recording
anomalies: Buttons appear icon-only with no visible labels—affordance unclear without tooltips or prior familiarity

ai_look: Icon-heavy horizontal toolbar is standard for media apps (Figma, zoom, Discord use similar)
Uniform icon sizing without clear primary action is a common toolbar pattern
30F6.why: Functional recording toolbar with good visual density. Recording state is evident from red dot + label and timer provides clear feedback. However, icon-only design trades discoverability for compactness; many buttons lack clear affordance. Hierarchy is flat—all icons are same size despite different functional importance. This is typical of media/collab tools but not exceptional. The design works if users are familiar with the flow, but discovery is not intuitive.
